rising.ranked_by: rank on AppBrain's top free games chart, excluding games already in the top-grossing list

rules: Mobile only: Google Play top-grossing games (segment 'grossing') and rising games from a new-games chart (segment 'rising').
A rising game already in the top-grossing list is kept once, as grossing.
Store IDs are exact; titles are for display only.
The emulator hides games that refuse emulators; a hidden game with a rank on another public chart is inserted at that rank, the rest are listed under charts.mobile.hidden.
